title: genmed-impact / denominator: a genetic-disease × genetic-medicine impact library and reproducible burden pipeline
description:
A reproducible pipeline and interactive webapp that derive the global burden of serious genetic disease and the comparative impact of existing interventions (preconception carrier screening, IVF + preimplantation genetic testing, prenatal diagnosis, newborn screening, and existing somatic therapies) versus germline embryo editing. The core deliverable is a structured library of serious genetic diseases mapped to their causal genes and to each intervention, with Monte-Carlo uncertainty and an explicitly isolated germline-editing residual. Accompanies the manuscript Genetic Medicine.

Code is licensed Apache-2.0; the curated data products are CC-BY-4.0. Third-party inputs (IHME GBD 2023, Orphanet, UN WPP, WHO, UNAIDS, World Bank) remain under their own licenses and are referenced rather than redistributed where their terms require it (notably GBD).
notes: Author order: SG, DAW, PS, JS.
